They just want the judgement in case XYZ. There's no function that directly returns the judgement of a case. The function law_firm_get_impactful_cases returns impactful cases for a law firm. That doesn't match the request. There's no function to get the judgement of a case. So we cannot use the function. We should respond that we don't have enough info or we can't retrieve that.
